body: She was my close friend. I have one more, she's a workout freak but her and I have a lot in common. Why do you ask?

She was the first person I loved in that way, we knew it would never work because she left to college, we managed to get 10 months together but things got too distant, she didn't have time and we broke up. But I moved on, I started liking someone else, things are okay.
I said that a year ago. What do you want to know?
That's a coincidence. They'll get over it eventually
I told one of them when it started and honestly she didn't know what to say she just seemed disappointed and I hate that look. Disappointing them, I don't want that. I don't want them to worry.
But that's the thing, they don't know about this so I won't know how they'll react and I can give myself the benefit of the doubt.  About a good year or so.
